# Original traversal reference

Original sources: Syntaxswine, Farmyard Fighters, commit
`7cd3d56e62a8087133a9fdf2f521cf92d310d6fd`.

The `original/` files retain their exact Git blob bytes, with `.original` appended
to distinguish reference evidence from executable Nautilus adapters. source.json
records the complete static script/JSON closure, original module edges, source
hashes and included original notices. Those notices remain authoritative for
their respective files; this record does not replace or extend their licenses.

The mixed original game module and its closure are reference only. No original
game script or resource is loaded by Nautilus or distributed as engine runtime.
The separate traversal module is an engine-owned contact adaptation. No donor
working file, consumer branch, production pin or game configuration was changed.
